lines: Morning or weekend swimmers, or anyone who works Tuesday evenings.
A swim session is not a small mix of the membership --- lap swimmers fill lap hours --- so
four clusters that all lean one way leave families and seniors out. Chance chose; the groups are alike inside.
Plan B, stratified: it samples the senior stratum separately, so 25 seniors are guaranteed
a place in proportion. No other plan promises seniors appear at all --- a random draw only makes it likely.
